assets.method: 原图按分段构图调整，不使用 AI 重绘。装饰等比缩放，只延长无装饰的边框直线段。

assets.prompt:
Edit the victory badge in reference 1 to be MUCH FLATTER AND MATTE, with COLOURED OUTLINES instead of black. Reference 2 is the original badge design and its warm ochre contour colour authority. Preserve reference 1's overall silhouette, complete composition, three stars, mushroom king's happy face, side mushrooms, foliage, ribbon and exact lettering, but remove its oily dimensional rendering.
CRITICAL STYLE CHANGE: Flat hand-drawn decorative 2D illustration. Each part has one calm matte base colour; at most one restrained flat adjacent-colour shape for a ribbon fold. NO smooth gradients, soft airbrush shading, glossy curved highlights, bright rim light, creamy shiny highlights, rounded-volume rendering, reflective folds, glare or 3D modelling of the cap, face or stars. Stars are simple flat gold shapes with a pale cream inner star; no beveled edges, shine or facets. The face and cap are predominantly solid flat colour. Use a few economical hand-drawn contour details, not dense texture. More like gently hand-coloured flat illustration than a mobile-game glossy mascot.
OUTLINES: ALL drawing strokes must be coloured warm muted OCHRE / golden brown (around #997848), medium-value and slightly softer than in reference 1, not black, nearly black, navy or very dark brown. Moderate thin line weight, no heavy thick outline. Face pupils and text also warm brown rather than black. Clear lettering may be somewhat darker warm umber (around #805C38), still visibly brown. No dark black outlines anywhere.
PALETTE: Muted champagne-gold, warm pale ivory, soft ochre and restrained amber. Cap becomes subdued ochre-gold, not bright orange/red; lower mushrooms have a very small dusty-rose/beige accent. Foliage muted warm olive/khaki-gold. Gentle controlled saturation. No metallic sheen, yellow glow or luminous gold.
TEXT must remain exactly "蘑菇们都很佩服你！", centred and clearly readable on the broad champagne banner, one line, with no extra words. Hand-drawn Chinese lettering in warm umber, simple and balanced.
One standalone landscape UI badge requested 1536 by 1024, full contour visible, generous transparent margin. Genuine transparent alpha in all open spaces and outside the badge. Reference 1's background colour/glow must not appear at all.
No grain, noise, speckles, stippling, paper/canvas texture, dirty mottling, bloom, glow, shadow halo, cast shadow, extra props, background, border, confetti, labels or watermark. Do not redesign the badge subject; change rendering, restrained palette and stroke colours only.

Use case: style-transfer. Create one independent FAILURE UI badge by redrawing reference 1 in a CLEAN FLAT MATTE hand-drawn finish. Reference 1 is exact subject, expression, composition and lettering authority. Reference 2 is the matching victory badge: use its simplified flat decorative construction and COLOURED medium-value contour drawing only, not its gold palette, happy face or stars.
Keep the recognisable mushroom-king badge from reference 1: large flared central cap with scalloped pale underside, round eyes, slightly worried brows and small sad downturned open mouth, symmetric curling organic foliage around the centre, two taller mushrooms on the sides and two small lower bell mushrooms, four restrained tear-shaped drops from the original motif, and a broad curved ribbon banner with folded ends. Keep the complete balanced silhouette.
COLOUR: Predominantly COOL BLUE / DESATURATED LAVENDER / grey periwinkle. Cap muted blue-violet; face and stems pale icy blue; foliage subdued blue-grey and dusty lilac; banner very pale blue-grey/lavender. Tear drops simple pale cool blue shapes. NO gold, orange, strong pink or electric purple. Low to moderate saturation.
OUTLINES: Every contour uses medium muted grey-blue / grey-violet, around #70758F; not black, near-black, dark navy or thick comic-book outlines. Pupils and clear text slightly darker muted slate-blue, around #58617D, still visibly coloured and not black. Moderately thin, clean confident hand-drawn strokes.
FLATNESS IS CRITICAL: One flat matte fill per main area, at most one simple adjacent colour plane for a ribbon fold or underside. No smooth gradients, airbrush rendering, glossy highlight swirls, specular reflection, bright rim lights, beveled surfaces, dimensional folds, rounded 3D volume or shiny mascot look. No white shine on caps, tears or face. Very sparse contour/gill lines; no textural paper. Like flat hand-coloured storybook UI art.
EXACT text on ribbon, one line: "糟糕！被蘑菇惹到了"
Exactly these characters in order: 糟 糕 ！ 被 蘑 菇 惹 到 了. Clearly readable hand-drawn Chinese lettering, centred and balanced, no other text. Preserve meaning and glyph accuracy.
One complete landscape UI badge requested 1536 by 1024, centred with comfortable transparent margins. Do not crop any tear point, mushroom, foliage curl or ribbon end. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside and through open spaces. No backdrop, rectangular panel or visible halo.
No stars, extra objects, other characters, scenery, particles, glitter, bloom, glow, cast shadows, noisy grain, stippling, speckles, dirty paper, excess texture, hatching, mud, oversaturation, photorealism, 3D rendering, watermark or labels. Preserve original design while changing palette and rendering style.

Create a GAME START sibling UI badge derived from the established mushroom badge family in the two references. Reference 1 is the structural design / friendly mushroom-king identity authority; reference 2 is the very simple flat matte rendering and medium-value coloured contour authority. Keep the decorative hand-drawn badge family, but make a new start-state variant.
SUBJECT: One friendly mushroom king in the centre, wide flared cap with scalloped pale underside, round calm attentive eyes and a small welcoming smile. Symmetric simple curling organic foliage and two tall side mushrooms plus two small lower bell-shaped mushrooms. A broad curved ribbon banner with folded ends is the main text area. Preserve a balanced complete ornamental silhouette. Remove ALL three victory stars from reference 1. No stars, tears or floating drops from either reference. No new icon or extra prop.
TEXT, verbatim, main ribbon: "游戏开始"
Exactly FOUR Chinese characters in order: 游 戏 开 始. Large simple hand-drawn Chinese lettering, centred on one line, balanced and very legible, with generous space around the glyphs. No secondary text or English.
COLOUR: A calm neutral START state combining desaturated teal / sage-blue and pale cool cream with a restrained dusty-rose cap accent and a small muted ochre-gold ribbon-fold accent. The main banner is pale cream/very pale sage, its lettering medium deep TEAL (#4A726B), visibly coloured rather than black. Face and stems pale blue-grey. Leaves muted blue-green, side caps subdued blue-grey and dusty rose. Colours must harmonise with the golden victory and blue-purple failure variants without duplicating either state.
ALL outlines must be medium-value COLOURED grey-teal / sage-petrol (#6A8A83), with a softer warm rose-brown contour on rose areas if needed. No black, near-black, dark navy or heavy outlines. Face pupils are muted deep teal, not black.
FLAT 2D HAND-COLOURED GAME ILLUSTRATION: Smooth matte solid colour fills, very few confident contour details. Maximum one restrained FLAT adjacent-colour plane for folds and undersides. No smooth gradients, airbrush colour modelling, glossy white highlights, bright rim lights, beveled shapes, reflections, 3D rounded volume, shiny gold or oily rendering. No shiny streaks on the cap, face or banner. Simple flat shapes and gentle hand-drawn edges, economical gill lines and leaf marks.
Landscape 1536 by 1024. One standalone complete badge with comfortable transparent margins, all mushroom caps, foliage curves and ribbon ends fully visible. True transparent alpha in the open spaces and all around the badge, not a coloured plate.
No noisy grain, paper texture, canvas, stippling, speckles, hatching, dirt, excess texture, muddiness, saturated pink/neon colours, blur, glow, bloom, halo, shadows, background, scenery, extra stars, crown, particles, label, watermark, icons or arbitrary extra objects. Deliver the GAME START badge only.
